actual: Nightly/CI LLM steps are wired but recent evidence shows llm_invoked=false. GitHub Models returns 429 or schema-invalid output, deepseek_api is disabled by default, and Nightly summary does not clearly show live invocation, fallback reason, advised plan keys, executed plan keys, or advice_consumed. Fix the validation/LLM workflow so DeepSeek can reliably provide guarded advisory test-plan/scheduler guidance with deterministic fallback, strict JSON repair/retry, and explicit consumption evidence, while keeping warning-only safety boundaries and no production actions.
